items.t: Viking Therapeutics (VKTX) Could Be 67% Undervalued Following New VK2735 Obesity Data
items.sum: Viking Therapeutics (VKTX) is back in focus after new clinical data from its VK2735 obesity program were featured at ObesityWeek 2026, highlighting shifts in body mass index categories and cardiometabolic markers. Recent clinical updates have arrived alongside sharp share price swings for Viking Therapeutics, with the stock up 6.44% on a 1-day share price return basis and 29.62% over 30 days, yet

items.t: Viking Therapeutics (VKTX) Stock Is Up 11.5% Today Without Company News
items.sum: On Monday, Nov. 23, shares rose 11.5% by 12:30 p.m. ET without company-specific news, as the S&P 500 gained 5.0%.
